evidence.trl_pathway: Most TRL progressions are reasonable: T02 (TRL7, 2yr development), T03 (TRL6, 1yr), T07 (TRL6, 1yr) are achievable, and T06 (TRL4, 2yr) is slightly aggressive but defensible given its dependency chain. No single jump is grossly infeasible.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio includes lower-TRL exploratory technologies (T06 at TRL4, T10 and T04 at TRL5) fitting 기술선도, but three of six technologies are TRL6-7 and heavily commercialization-adjacent; the R&D depth expected for true technology leadership is diluted by these near-market selections.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All selected technologies are squarely within the Conversational AI / LLM / Knowledge Graph domain, showing strong domain fit. The dependency chain from accelerator architecture through knowledge graph automation to security and document modeling reflects a coherent technology stack differentiation strategy.
evidence.market_timing: The mean timing error of 2.29 years is substantial. Even under 기술선도 norms (completing 1-2 years before boom), T06 misses by 3.25yr, T07 by 3.5yr, and T10 by 2.5yr — these complete well after their respective boom windows, forfeiting preemption advantage entirely.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: Technologies like T02 (graph-based AI accelerator) and T03 (knowledge graph response automation) appear to sit at credible patent-market intersections for the LLM/KG domain, but the roadmap provides no explicit evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting; alignment appears structural rather than analytically intentional.

strengths: All selected technologies are domain-coherent with Conversational AI / LLM / Knowledge Graph, ensuring the company competes where it has established advantage

weaknesses: Systematic late completion across most technologies — 5 of 6 technologies complete after their market boom windows, undermining both preemption and profit maximization objectives

missing_technologies: Low-TRL (TRL2-3) foundational LLM reasoning or multi-agent coordination research technology to anchor the 기술선도 strategy
Federated or privacy-preserving knowledge graph technology to complement the security management track
investment_issues: Strategic tier assigned to 맥락 기반 접근 지능 보안 관리 despite a 3.5-year timing miss — high investment in a technology that will arrive into a post-peak market is capital inefficient
